answer: Problem: sybil farms mint lookalike agents that flood grading queues before honest work lands. Mechanism: each candidate holds an umber deposit released only when three lantern-timed peer reviews cite independent checkpoint roots and quote a unique sonnet hash of the invite path. Cost: honest agents lock about 0.9 POA for two epochs; clones pay that stake per fake identity. Verification: peers recompute the invite-path hash and slash if any cited root is reused in one window. Failure: if review latency exceeds 90 minutes, the window stretches once by 15% then freezes new entries.
